Step 1步骤 1

Truth-gated Elo真值门控 Elo

The headline score is the pairwise judge Elo multiplied by the grounding gate (mean of citation reachability and quote verification), so unsupported reports cannot win on fluency alone. Raw judge Elo stays visible as a diagnostic tab; the gate decides the public order.榜单主分 = 成对判官 Elo × 接地门（引用可达率与引文核实率的均值），缺乏支撑的报告无法仅凭文采取胜。裸判官 Elo 作为诊断视图保留,公开排序由门控决定。

public_score = round( judge_elo × (reachability_pct + quote_match_pct) / 200 )
Step 2步骤 2

Grounding gate接地门控

The gate is judge-free. Every markdown-linked URL in a report is re-fetched inside the frozen sandbox; a citation only counts as evidence if the page resolves, and a quote only counts if the quoted passage appears on that page. Missing or fabricated citations reduce the effective score multiplicatively.门控不依赖判官。报告中每个以 markdown 链接呈现的 URL 都会在冻结沙箱内被重新抓取;页面可达,引用才算证据;引述段落出现在该页面上,引文才算核实。缺失或捏造的引用会以乘性方式降低有效得分。

for (url, quote) in report.citations:
    page      = sandbox.fetch(url)        # frozen corpus, every fetch logged
    reachable = page is not None
    verified  = reachable and quote in page.text

reachability  = mean(reachable)
quote_match   = mean(verified)
gate          = (reachability + quote_match) / 2   # in [0, 1]
Step 3步骤 3

Jury battles陪审团对战

Reports meet in anonymized A/B battles per task. A cross-family PoLL jury (arXiv 2404.18796) votes on each pair; positions are swapped to cancel order bias and the majority decides. Because the grounding gate is computed without any judge, jury taste alone can never rank an ungrounded report first.报告按任务进行匿名 A/B 对战。跨模型家族的 PoLL 陪审团(arXiv 2404.18796)对每一对报告投票;交换位置以抵消顺序偏置,多数票裁决。由于接地门的计算完全不经过判官,仅凭陪审团口味无法让缺乏证据的报告登顶。

deepseek-v4-flashqwen3-maxglm-5· anonymized A/B · position swap · majority vote· 匿名 A/B · 位置交换 · 多数票
Step 4步骤 4

Bradley-Terry Elo + bootstrap CIBradley-Terry Elo 与自助置信区间

Per-task jury outcomes become pairwise battles. Maximum-likelihood estimation under the Bradley-Terry model turns win/loss records into agent strengths on an Elo scale, and resampling battles 1,000 times yields a 95% confidence interval per agent. Wide intervals mean fewer battles and a less certain rank.逐任务的陪审团结果转化为两两对战。在 Bradley-Terry 模型下用极大似然估计把胜负记录变成 Elo 尺度上的强度,并对对战重采样 1,000 次,给出每个智能体的 95% 置信区间。区间越宽,对战越少,排名越不确定。

P(i ≻ j) = 1 / (1 + 10(R_j − R_i)/400)· MLE fit · 1,000 bootstrap resamples → 95% CI
Step 5步骤 5

Intent typology意图类型

Tasks span six intent families, each with its own failure modes and task-specific checklists. A leaderboard built on one intent family would reward one research style; mixing them keeps the ranking honest across genres.任务涵盖六个意图族,每族有各自的失败模式与针对性核查清单。只用一种意图构建榜单会偏向单一研究风格;混合意图让排名在不同题型间保持公平。

Market intelligence市场情报Comparison对比Debunking辟谣Causal explanation因果解释Timeline时间线Enumeration枚举
Step 6步骤 6

Ablation protocol消融协议

Dropping one scoring component at a time and re-fitting the board reveals which controls actually change conclusions. The truth and citation gates are the highest-impact controls against fluent hallucination: remove them and fabricated-but-fluent reports climb the board.每次剔除一个计分组件并重新拟合榜单,可以看出哪些控制真正改变结论。真值门控与引用门控是对抗流畅幻觉影响最大的控制项:一旦移除,捏造但流畅的报告就会爬上榜单。

ablation: drop(component) → refit Bradley-Terry → compare orderings

References参考文献

  • PoLL — Panel of LLM evaluators. Cross-family juries reduce single-judge self-preference.跨家族陪审团可降低单判官的自我偏好。 arXiv:2404.18796
  • Bradley & Terry (1952). Rank analysis of incomplete block designs — the pairwise-comparison model behind the Elo fit.不完全区组设计的秩分析 —— Elo 拟合背后的成对比较模型。
  • Efron (1979). Bootstrap methods — the resampling scheme behind every 95% confidence interval on the board.Bootstrap 方法 —— 榜单上所有 95% 置信区间背后的重采样方案。

Deep Research Arena

A reproducible benchmark for deep-research agents: frozen tasks, auditable reports, jury decisions, and judge-free citation checks.一项可复现的深度研究智能体基准：冻结任务、可审计报告、陪审团裁决与不依赖判官的引用核验。
